cases.purpose: Separate free lateral surfaces and shear/grip response from strain/reaction formula errors; existing saved data do not isolate this cause
cases.main_change: Fixed x/y periodic600um cell with complete cross-boundary neighbors; all other M2 definitions unchanged
cases.stop: 40000 accepted steps, no extension based on G outcome
cases.decision: If G approaches940 with uniform ROI and consistent reactions, boundary/stress-field mismatch is a major cause; do not claim mesh convergence

cases.purpose: Test zero axial strain within rigid collar as source of competing grip-transition concentration
cases.main_change: Only axial displacement profile inside existing150um collars: u_z=disp(t)*Z/H instead of +/-disp/2. Same collar mean displacement, same free tangential DOFs, all interior DOFs free
cases.stop: 48000 accepted steps fixed; no weakening/no manual event deletion/no constrained crack path
cases.measurement: Report resultant top reaction/initial face area and generalized load Q=-sum(F_mat*sign); external work uses each actual prescribed displacement, not R_top*d(mean opening) when collar strains
cases.decision: Apply frozen region/connected-front/area gates; fail honestly and stop if non-target failure remains
